clue.text: British port and spirit

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro, the Brazilian port, is often just Rio

explanation.surface: A drinks order: a British port wine and a shot of spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' and 'spirit' both pretend to be drinks; port is a harbour city and spirit is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Brio is vigour or liveliness of manner, the same sense as spirit in a lively performance.

clue.text: Type of liar who needs no unmasking?

definitions.text: Type of liar who needs no unmasking?

parts.words: Type of liar who needs no unmasking?
parts.note: a shameless liar's face is already bare, so there is no mask to remove

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase 'barefaced liar' is literalised: a bare face has nothing to unmask.
explanation.definitionFit: A barefaced lie is told shamelessly and openly, with no attempt at disguise.

clue.text: Busily working in the navy, maybe

definitions.text: Busily working in the navy, maybe

parts.words: Busily working in the navy, maybe
parts.note: the military phrase for serving in operations, read as merely being very active, with the navy as one service

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase hints at a busy worker and the navy as one of the armed services.
explanation.definitionFit: On active service describes armed forces personnel serving in operations, such as sailors at sea.

clue.text: Agree officer has right to reply

parts.note: CO is short for commanding officer
to reply is to respond

explanation.surface: An officer is entitled to answer back.
explanation.definitionFit: Two accounts that correspond agree or match each other.

clue.text: Queen perhaps with two words of hesitation for provider of food

parts.note: a queen is a female cat
er is a sound of hesitation, so two of them give ER twice

explanation.surface: A monarch umming and erring over who should supply the food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Queen' points at royalty; a queen is also a female cat.
explanation.definitionFit: A caterer supplies food and drink for events.

clue.text: What greens do on bike

parts.note: re means concerning, so on in the sense of about
to cycle is to ride a bike

explanation.surface: Environmentalists ride bicycles.
explanation.definitionFit: Environmentally minded people reuse waste materials, which is recycling.

clue.text: Stop mutated mice native to a particular area

parts.note: end means stop

indicators.note: mutated means changed in form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A call to halt genetically altered mice spreading in a local habitat.
explanation.definitionFit: An endemic species or disease is found regularly in one particular region.

clue.text: Spice and herb with top of the milk that's sweet

parts.note: pepper is a spice
mint is a herb
cream rises to the top of unhomogenised milk

explanation.surface: A recipe combining spice, herb and cream into a dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: A peppermint cream is a mint-flavoured fondant sweet, a confection.

clue.text: Trick magistrate to lock up Democrat

indicators.note: lock up means to imprison, so one word encloses the other

parts.note: the doge was the chief magistrate of Venice or Genoa

explanation.surface: A judge cunningly jails a political opponent.
explanation.definitionFit: A dodge is a cunning trick or scheme to evade something.

clue.text: Sentimental type having nervous reaction

parts.note: roman is a style of printing type, upright rather than italic
a tic is an involuntary twitch, a nervous reaction

explanation.surface: Someone soft-hearted who twitches when anxious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sentimental type' looks like the definition, but 'type' is the printing face roman.
explanation.definitionFit: A romantic outlook is an idealised, emotional one, which is what sentimental describes.

clue.text: Trust European leaving part of swimming pool?

indicators.note: leaving says the European letter departs from the pool phrase, so it is taken out

parts.note: the deep end is the part of a pool where you cannot stand

explanation.surface: Trusting a European who climbs out of the deep end of a pool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaving' removes one E from DEEP END.
explanation.definitionFit: To depend on someone is to rely on or trust them; the verbs share this sense.

clue.text: Agent in favour of entertaining turn

indicators.note: entertaining in the sense of hosting a guest, so one word holds the other inside

parts.note: being for something means being in favour of it
a turn is a stage act in variety

explanation.surface: An agent who approves of a variety act.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' is a music-hall act, so 'entertaining' doubles as a hint to the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: A factor is a commercial agent who buys and sells goods for someone else.

clue.text: Force to cover two miles in traffic

indicators.note: cover means one word wraps round the other and holds it inside

parts.note: to coerce is to force
M is miles, so two of them give MM

explanation.surface: Being compelled to drive two miles through heavy traffic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'traffic' looks like road traffic; here it means trade.
explanation.definitionFit: Traffic can mean dealing or trading in goods, which is commerce.

clue.text: Fish paid for at the door

definitions.meaning: ..., cash on delivery, is payment when goods arrive

explanation.surface: A fish delivered and paid for on the doorstep.
explanation.definitionFit: The fish name and the abbreviation for cash on delivery share these letters.

clue.text: Meet and study border

parts.note: to con is an old word for to study or learn
a verge is an edge or border, as of a road

explanation.surface: An instruction to gather and examine a boundary.
explanation.definitionFit: Lines or people that converge come together at one point, so they meet.

clue.text: My code cracked? That's amusing

indicators.note: a code that is cracked is broken open, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone finds it funny that their secret code has been broken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cracked' rearranges MYCODE. The definition is a phrase: something amusing is comedy.
explanation.definitionFit: Comedy is entertainment designed to be funny, so it is the thing that amuses.

clue.text: Beatles' hit not long ago

explanation.surface: A Beatles song from the recent past.
explanation.definitionFit: The Beatles song title doubles as the word for the recent past.

clue.text: Young woman distributed medals

indicators.note: distributed means spread around, so the letters are dealt out in a new order

explanation.surface: A girl hands out medals at a prize-giving.
explanation.definitionFit: Damsel is an old or literary word for a young unmarried woman.

clue.text: A couple of new drivers will get the lot

parts.note: L is a learner, so two learner drivers give LL

explanation.surface: Two learner drivers will receive everything.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a learner driver displays an L plate.
explanation.definitionFit: All and the lot both mean everything.

clue.text: Permit silence to be shattered

indicators.note: something shattered is broken into pieces, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: Permission to break the silence.
explanation.walkthrough: LICENSE is the verb spelling in British English.
explanation.definitionFit: To license is to authorise or permit officially.

clue.text: Trade, one might be asked to mind one's own

definitions.text: one might be asked to mind one's own
definitions.meaning: the idiom 'mind your own ...' tells someone not to interfere

explanation.surface: Commerce, and the thing a nosy person is told to keep to.
explanation.definitionFit: Business is both buying and selling and, in the idiom, one's private affairs.

clue.text: Ban logo redesigned for European city

indicators.note: redesigned means made in a new form, so the letters take a new order

explanation.surface: A logo prohibition leads to a new design for a city's branding.
explanation.definitionFit: Bologna is a city in northern Italy.

clue.text: Jump suddenly, brilliant performer put about

parts.note: a star is a brilliant performer

indicators.note: about signals the word put is turned round to read backwards

explanation.surface: A star leaps up when annoyed.
explanation.definitionFit: To start up is to rise or spring up abruptly, as in surprise.

clue.text: Related to a man of the cloth?

definitions.text: Related to a man of the cloth?

parts.words: Related to a man of the cloth?
parts.note: reads as being a priest's relative, but means pertaining to the clergy

explanation.walkthrough: 'Related to' looks like kinship, as if the answer were a family member; it just means concerning.
explanation.definitionFit: Clerical describes the clergy, men of the cloth being priests or ministers.

clue.text: Snake having firm support

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm
a bra is a supporting garment

explanation.surface: A snake with a strong backing.
explanation.definitionFit: The cobra is a venomous hooded snake.

clue.text: Mysterious beggar can enter houses

indicators.note: houses says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A puzzling beggar is allowed into people's homes.
explanation.definitionFit: Arcane knowledge is secret or understood by few, hence mysterious.

clue.text: Kind governor initially found in country

indicators.note: found in says that letter sits inside the country

parts.note: Benin is a country in West Africa

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of the word governor

explanation.surface: A gentle ruler discovered in some nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Benign means gentle and well-disposed, a synonym of kind.

clue.text: Picked up and assembled

definitions.meaning: picked up or collected, as flowers or understanding
... also means came or brought together

explanation.surface: Collected and brought together.
explanation.definitionFit: To gather is both to pick up things and to bring people together in one place.

clue.text: Help prince finally run off to find adjutant

parts.note: aid means help

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of the word prince

parts.note: to decamp is to run off suddenly

explanation.surface: A prince helped flee in search of an officer.
explanation.definitionFit: An aide-de-camp is an officer assisting a senior commander, much like an adjutant.

clue.text: Mother goes to New York a lot

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: Mum frequently travels to New York.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a lot' reads as 'often' in the surface; it is the definition, meaning many.
explanation.definitionFit: Many and a lot both mean a large number.
